options.gain: A ruling you give in chat cannot sit unrecorded with no one noticing.

options.label: Rulings that never land (Recommended)
options.lose: The other three wait a round.

options.gain: You learn how much of the work serves this repo's own tools instead of your other repos.
options.how: About 89% of the 746 open steps work on this repo's own machinery: merge, review and lint. This is an inference from the step titles.
options.label: Steps on this repo's own machinery
options.lose: The figure is an inference from titles, so the round starts by measuring it.

options.gain: Notes either reach a reader or stop being written.
options.how: The triage outbox: 563 notes, about 6% acted on. Stop writing to it, or give it a named reader.
options.label: The triage outbox
options.lose: Lost notes stay lost until this round runs.

options.gain: Guards that refuse good work get fixed or removed.
options.how: Guards with recorded false alarms: the report guard has 15, the frozen-path guard 6.
options.label: Guards with false alarms
